senses.en_definition: For a long, continuous period; always; forever.

messages.en: He hasn't replied about dinner this Saturday for two days now. Are we going to keep waiting?
We can't wait forever. Ask him one more time. If he still hasn't replied by tonight, we'll just book for those who've confirmed.

senses.en_definition: Safe; protected from harm or out of danger.
Secure and at peace; free from disturbance or worry.
A blessing or prayer for well-being, protection or the fulfilment of wishes, or in thanksgiving.

collocations.en: a prayer for safety and well-being
a communal feast held to seek blessings or give thanks

senses.en_definition: Used in greetings, welcomes and expressions of good wishes.

messages.en: Are you home yet, Aina? It's raining so heavily. I'm worried about you.
Yes, Mum. I'm home safe and sound. I drove nice and slowly.

senses.en_definition: To save or rescue someone or something from danger or harm.
To save something from destruction, decline, failure or disappearance.
In certain religious beliefs, to save someone from punishment for sin or eternal damnation.

messages.en: Can you help rescue the kitten in the drain outside my house? It can't climb out on its own.
Sure, I'll come over now. Grab a box first so we can put it in there.

senses.en_definition: South; the direction opposite to north.

collocations.en: in the southern part of the peninsula

messages.en: We're heading south first tomorrow, right? Fancy stopping off in Melaka along the way?
Sure. Let's have breakfast in Seremban first, then carry on to Melaka.
